APPROVE_AT_DECLARED_GRAIN.why: Every O1-C01 through O1-C05 closure survived independent challenge, and I re-derived each substantive claim rather than accepting it. The commit graph is lawful with zero unrelated ancestry and zero production changes. All 14 pinned production/test blobs are exact at head, C4A and C4C3, and the rawlsing_next tree hash is identical across the whole lineage. All 36 imported evidence blobs are exact. All eight source SHA-256s agree four ways and all fourteen Omega-1 oracle identity rules match. The 280-cell ledger arithmetic recomputes exactly with zero PASS cells and all nine claim ceilings byte-identical and in order. The warrant candidate's digest recomputes to the declared value exactly, all seven locators are explicitly unfilled, SRC35 is correctly excluded, and I found no path or locator anywhere in the packet. The Route-B producer binding, which C4B did not name, is independently confirmed correct and unique. No finding invalidates any closure. The two substantive items I found are a repair at issuance and a precondition at live execution, and one apparent gap I closed affirmatively with my own computation. The bookkeeping errors all understate coverage.

CHANGES_REQUIRED.why_not: Nothing found requires rework of the freeze itself. R1, R4, R5, R6, R10 and R11 are documentary repairs of varying weight and none invalidates an O1-C01..C05 closure. R9 is a repair to the warrant instrument, which does not yet exist as an issued document and is out of scope for the freeze. R7 is a live-execution precondition already covered by the freeze's own invalidation law. Rework of a source-free freeze that verifies this cleanly would be disproportionate.

TYPED_RESIDUAL.why_not: I do carry eleven typed residuals and they are enumerated in full in 06_OPEN_ITEMS_AND_RESIDUALS.json, but none of them contradicts or qualifies a closure. The commission's own framing makes APPROVE_AT_DECLARED_GRAIN the disposition that carries the residual schedule, since an approval at declared grain is by definition approval together with a record of what remains typed and open. Choosing TYPED_RESIDUAL instead would suggest the freeze stands only as a residual rather than as a sound freeze, which is not what I found. The residuals are attached to this approval rather than substituted for it.

ESCALATE_WITH_COUNTEREXAMPLE.why_not: I found no counterexample to any closure, no law weakened, no provenance drift, no cross-owner conflict, no oracle binding gap and no runtime binding gap. Specifically: the fan-in's own concern about binding a module C4B did not name is not a counterexample, because I independently proved the binding correct. The fan-in's own accounting figures are not a counterexample, because they understate rather than overstate. C4B's stale-base observation of the C3 blobs is not a counterexample, because C4B framed it as an execution-head precondition and that precondition is satisfied. Nothing here warrants Astra escalation.
